title: confiture check translations --format json
description: Per translation table db/project.yaml declares (translations:) and per required locale, how many live entity rows have no live translation, and the first few of their keys. A table i18n_001 refuses is named in not_counted, never counted. A database that cannot be reached writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json).

locales.description: The required locales, from translations.required or translations.required_query, in that order.

missing.description: Every entity row missing a translation, over every table and locale.

table.description: The translation table, as the tree names it.

locales.description: One entry per required locale, in the order of locales.

missing.description: Live entity rows with no live translation in this locale.

sample.description: The first missing entity keys, in key order, as text (a composite key's parts joined by ', '); at most --sample.

unknown_locales.description: Required locales the locale table does not hold: every entity misses them.

not_counted.description: i18n_001's findings: a translation table, or the declaration, the count could not read.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
